WITH attendance_by_status AS (
    SELECT e.status, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendees
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.status
)
SELECT status,
       attendees,
       CAST(attendees AS REAL) / SUM(attendees) OVER () AS share
FROM attendance_by_status;
